prompt:
Using the supplied original character image as identity + materials reference and templated empty edit canvas as layout guide, draw a PROFESSIONAL PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS for a polished high-end stylized 3D mobile brawler game. EXACTLY 16 completely separate full-body drawings lined up in a perfectly regular invisible FOUR COLUMN × FOUR ROW square grid. All 16 are the same character, same costume / head / limb / weapon scale and length, same camera 3/4 facing RIGHT (his/her nose always slightly screen-right), exactly the polished color and rendered material of the model sheet. THIS IS FRAME-BY-FRAME ART: actually re-pose the arms, legs, face, costume and weapon to distinct keyframe positions instead of rotating a static model. Every character completely isolated in its own square, finger/hair/weapon/boots included. All cells same scale and full standing height about 75% of each cell leaving at least 10% fully transparent space in every direction. Feet share baseline. No lettering, no labels, no grid lines, no separators, no scenery or ground or shadow discs whatsoever. Truly transparent blank alpha background. Never duplicate frames except that loops end smoothly.
READ row-by-row:
ROW ONE across from left to right: a 4-keyframe calm standing IDLE cycle; feet planted side by side, gentle inhaling, chin lift/blink, exhale, relaxed. 
ROW TWO left to right: a clearly distinct powerful running loop facing RIGHT. 1 front left knee/foot aggressively outstretched and RIGHT arm forward, rear right heel raised; 2 push-off and passing/legs close, torso dips; 3 opposing step, RIGHT knee/foot outstretched and LEFT arm forward, rear left heel raised; 4 passing/recovery with knees bent. Big visible silhouette contrast in all 4 foot positions, elbows bent and counter-swing visibly. Preserve all legs fully visible. 
ROW THREE: dramatic expressive four-keyframe weapon attack with an unmistakable windup, big peak anticipation, impact, followthrough. See character-specific choreography below. 
ROW FOUR: (1) hit reaction folds torso into guard / eyes squeezed in pain, (2) recoils arched backwards right-facing again with clenched teeth, (3) crumples on one bent knee exhausted, (4) fully defeated lying horizontally on its side on the ground looking dazed or eyes closed: much shorter/LOWER screen height but occupying same scale, all costume retained. 
Arrange exactly FOUR rows of FOUR heroes. No large FX detached from bodies, no explosions or extraneous objects. Crisp detailed collectible high end 3D rendering, directional highlights on left, subdued shadow masses, unified vibrant color palette around strong silhouettes.
Stout round bright green ribbed cactus cowboy, cheerful sturdy brow, small branching cactus tips, brown cowboy hat, orange bandana and two brass seed pistols. Attack in row three: 1 planting foot holster-low, 2 drew back one pistol aiming screen-right, 3 brings that pistol level and recoils with a short orange muzzle-star, 4 lowers that gun and raises other gun to ready, grin. Keep distinguishing head and neck chief. Running his two pistols track the swings of his arms.
